status_note: Live and battle-tested: this exact image runs in a production AWS Nitro enclave guarding real Telegram accounts. Not a development, staging, or testnet build. The release is commit-pinned and reproducible; trust comes from rebuilding it and matching the PCR0 below, plus the live in-browser attestation.
gateway_commit_repo: github.com/Danimal01/enclave-gateway (THIS repository) — resolve gateway_commit/the tag here, not elsewhere; tag v1.0.7 is the source that builds to pcr0_g.
allowlist_sha256_preimage: IMPORTANT: allowlist_sha256 is INTENTIONALLY DIFFERENT from files[].sha256 below and is NOT supposed to equal it (this is not a mismatch). allowlist_sha256 = sha256 over the UTF-8 string '// FILE tg-chokepoint.mjs\n' concatenated with the file's bytes -- the attestation-binding digest the live attestation binds and the how-it-works page verifies. files[].sha256 = the plain `sha256sum tg-chokepoint.mjs`. Two verifiers, two values, same file.

files.name: tg-chokepoint.mjs
files.note: raw sha256 of the file bytes; matches `sha256sum tg-chokepoint.mjs`. Intentionally DIFFERS from the top-level allowlist_sha256 (the attestation-binding digest) -- see allowlist_sha256_preimage.

reproducible_note: umask-independent: a 644 and a 664 source context build the IDENTICAL PCR0 (the Dockerfile canonicalizes every COPYed file's mode; .gitattributes pins LF). The three host-staged binaries above are pinned by sha256 so a verifier can confirm them. Build on any host and match.
transparency: To verify: check out tag v1.0.7 of THIS repository, rebuild per BUILD.md, and confirm the PCR0 matches pcr0_g. The tag is the exact source that builds to pcr0_g.

attestation.note: A live AWS Nitro enclave running this exact image attests PCR0_G above (the live artifact is authoritative for the current module id and timestamp). The capability allowlist (tg-chokepoint.mjs) is account-management only: no message, chat, file, or contact method. The one call whose reply can carry message updates, updates.getDifference, is read single-branch (only otherUpdates) and its newMessages are discarded unread.

note: Production release v1.0.7: fixes an eviction-LOGGING loop with NO capability change (allowlist_sha256 and files[].sha256 are byte-identical to v1.0.6). After a successful account.resetAuthorization, Telegram can keep LISTING the terminated session as a ghost in account.getAuthorizations for minutes; the detection sweep recomputed its target set from the live roster each cycle with no memory, so it re-removed + re-logged + re-emailed the same already-killed session every ~7s until Telegram GCs it. The gateway now dedups against the durable eviction_log keyed on the per-session hash: a hash removed within a 30-min cooldown is not re-proposed (a real new login always carries a NEW hash, so a genuine intruder is never suppressed), a cooled-still-listed ghost is excluded from the roster baseline so it is never misreported as a new login or a sign-out-elsewhere, and a session that genuinely persists past the window falls back into the normal gated batch and is surfaced to the operator. Carries forward v1.0.6 reliable instant new-login detection (updates.getDifference state machine), v1.0.5 activity-log accuracy, v1.0.4 warmth, v1.0.3 SRP, v1.0.2 disconnect-execution. Deterministic, umask-independent reproducibility.
